findings.evidence: Hermitian.lean:51-55 `def hermitianAverage ... := TauCeti.meanRiemannianMetric (fun b : Bool ↦ if b then g.pullbackBundleEquiv (fun x ↦ Complex.smulIEquiv (V x)) TauCeti.contMDiff_smulIEquiv_bundle else g)`; Hermitian.lean:59-85 and 200-206 have the same inner/invariance/eq_self/existence proof shapes as AreaForm.lean compatibleAverage_inner (`2⁻¹ * (g.inner x u v + g.inner x (j x u) (j x v))`) and the `ring` proofs.
findings.fix: Factor one construction in Geometry/Manifold/VectorBundle/Riemannian (for example, average with the pullback by `A : ∀ x, V x ≃L[ℝ] V x` that has a `C^n` hom-bundle section and satisfies `A x (A x v) = -v`), with its half-sum, invariance, fixed-point and existence lemmas. Instantiate it with `j.tangentEquiv`/`contMDiff_tangentEquiv` here and with `Complex.smulIEquiv`/`contMDiff_smulIEquiv_bundle` in Hermitian.lean, so the lemmas aren't proved twice.
findings.issue: `compatibleAverage`, `compatibleAverage_inner`, `compatibleAverage_inner_apply_apply`, `compatibleAverage_eq_self` and `exists_contMDiffRiemannianMetric_compatible` duplicate `Bundle.ContMDiffRiemannianMetric.hermitianAverage`, `hermitianAverage_inner`, `hermitianAverage_inner_smul_I`, `hermitianAverage_eq_self_iff` and `TauCeti.exists_contMDiffRiemannianMetric_inner_smul_I`. Both are `meanRiemannianMetric (fun b : Bool ↦ if b then g.pullbackBundleEquiv A hA else g)` for a fibrewise automorphism `A` with `A² = -1`; only `A` differs (`j.tangentEquiv` versus `Complex.smulIEquiv`).

findings.evidence: MetricChange.lean:101-105: `have : Continuous fun y : e.baseSet ↦ TotalSpace.mk' ℝ (E := Bundle.Trivial B ℝ) (y : B) (h.inner y (σ y w) (σ y w')) := (h.continuous.comp continuous_subtype_val).clm_bundle_apply₂ (F₁ := F) (F₂ := F) (hσ w) (hσ w'); exact continuous_snd.comp ((Bundle.Trivial.homeomorphProd B ℝ).continuous.comp this)`. Mathlib's `Continuous.inner_bundle` (Topology/VectorBundle/Riemannian.lean:128) with the instance at :497 covers the registered-instance case.
findings.fix: Replace the inline block at TauCeti/Topology/VectorBundle/Riemannian/MetricChange.lean:101-105 with `h.continuous_inner_of_continuous (hσ w) (hσ w')` (composed with `continuous_subtype_val` for the base), so the new lemma is the single source of this argument.
findings.issue: `ContinuousRiemannianMetric.continuous_inner_of_continuous` repeats an existing inline proof: MetricChange.lean already proves the same continuity with the same `h.continuous.comp ... |>.clm_bundle_apply₂ (F₁ := F) (F₂ := F)` plus `continuous_snd.comp ((Bundle.Trivial.homeomorphProd B ℝ).continuous.comp _)` chain.

summary: The L² pairing, area-form identification and conformal-factor lemma are new, but `compatibleAverage` and its lemmas clone the existing `hermitianAverage` API, and `continuous_inner_of_continuous` duplicates a proof already inlined in MetricChange.lean.
